profile.headline: Wireless Protocol Engineer with strong expertise of 5GNR and LTE Protocol and Compliance on Device SW Development, Testing, Planning and Technical Leadership.
profile.geoLocationName: Basking Ridge, New Jersey, United States
profile.jobTitle: Consultant Software Engineer at Verizon Wireless
profile.summary:
● Over 15 years as Wireless Protocol Engineer (5GNR and LTE) with strong expertise on Device SW Development, Testing, Planning and Technical Leadership.
● Rich experience in the verification of 5GNR NSA/SA and LTE devices for Verizon Wireless through tech-activities on protocol and performance with device OEMs/chipset/Network Venders  
● Effectively capable of working directly with all major cellular operators, OEMs and chipset vendors. 
● Outstanding analytical and problem-solving through excellent collaboration and teamwork skills : Operator Requirement / Gating issue Analysis, Day-to-Day Engagement with Carrier, Coordination with Various R&D teams on Software and Product Readiness and certifications.
 
● Technical expertise and Rich experience of operator certification testing (Verizon Wireless/TMO/Sprint SFN and Lab. IOT or NVIOT) : 5GNR NSA/SA, 5GNR CPE, LTE-A MIMO CA/LAA data performance and protocol testing

positions.title: Consultant Software Engineer at Verizon Wireless
positions.locationName: Basking Ridge, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
● 5GNR NSA/SA and LTE Protocol and Performance Tech-Activities including the New 5G chipset validation (Testing / Analysis / Debugging / Trouble-shooting) with OEMs, Chipset Vendors and Network Vendors : FR2(mmW) 5GNR Max. Throughput Testing(8CC), FR1(Sub.6) device testing, 5GNR CPE product commercialization activities, Emergency call over 5GNR NSA/SA, the new E911 tech. features collaboration, 5GNR SA Emergency call via EPS Fallback/VoNR, Z-axis, 911 to SMS, LPPe) 
● VZW 5GNR/LTE Requirement/Test Plan Development (5GNR SA Option2 Device Requirements, 5GNR VoWiFi ePDG TCs, 5GNR NSA Mobility Requirement, 5G SA Emergency EPS Fallback Requirement and Test Plan)
● VZW 5GNR/LTE Tech. Review and Compliance Activities for Commercial TA : Reviewing OEM CSR and following up 5GNR LTE and E911 Compliance issues such as Product’s Lab test, NV-IOT and Field issues

positions.title: Consultant Lead Test Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
● Technical Lead on modem performance and protocol test, analysis and debug on LTE-A/IRAT/SRLTE/hVoLTE for Verizon Wireless, Sprint and TMO 
   o LTE-A MIMO CA, LAA data performance, IRAT, CMAS, SRLTE and hVoLTE testing with R&S PQA / Anritsu 8480 RTD TE
   o LTE/CDMA/EVDO/IRAT/GMSS/hVoLTE Safety For Network (SFN), Lab Conformance(LC), GCF, PTCRB, Network vendors’ lab Inter-Operability Test (NV-IOT)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer (2014~2016)
positions.description:
● Protocol Lead for the new chipset devices (Media Tek)
   o Successful launch of LG’s MTK chipset devices (VZW Stylo 2 V and Sprint X Power)
   o Protocol testing, analyzing and debug on VZW/Sprint LTE/CDMA/EVDO/VoLTE certification
● Excellent collaboration activities and demonstration on the new LTE performance feature

company.name: LG Electronics Mobile Communication, Seoul, Korea

positions.title: Technical Account Manag for VZW LTE/IRAT/VoLTE
positions.description:
● Technical leadership as SME for Verizon Wireless LTE/CDMA/EVDO/IRAT/VoLTE: 
   o Supported LTE 3GPP Band 13/4 RF,RRM and RAN Signaling Conformance testing, LTE Device-UICC testing with strong experiences on LTE/SVLTE/EVDO/CDMA2000/IRAT specifications 
   o Agile and insightful issue management skills on LTE/VoLTE Lab. test, NV-IOT and RF Field test with VZW Device Technology and VZW NDET Lab.
● Strong deliverable through the tight collaboration with VZW
   o Supported all new features on LTE/EVDO/1xRTT/IRAT/VoLTE Network vendors IOT and FT
   o In-depth reviews of tech. req., test plans and tech. trainings for carrier or cross functional teams.
   o Played a key role in development planning, testing and technical supports to carrier.

company.name: LG Electronics Mobile Communication Seoul Korea

positions.title: LTE Protocol / IOT Lead (Chief Software Engineer)
positions.description:
● Lead LTE/CDMA/EVDO/IRAT testing with LG in-house LTE firmware modem (L2000), LTE modem devices (LG M13, G13, VL600) and LTE SW development (LTE RRC, NAS, IRAT). 
● LTE collaboration IODT/IOT activities with the authorized carriers, NW vendors and Equip. vendors: 
   o Carrier IOT : Verizon Wireless (IOT Phase 3/4,FOA), AT&T, Docomo and Orange. 
   o Network Vendor IOT : ALU, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei and Nortel.
   o Test Equipment Vendor IOT : R&S, Spirent, W2Bi, Aeroflex and Accuver(Inno-Wireless) 
● Proven experience of the SW development : Lead the development and the demonstration of the world's-first LTE/IRAT handover (http://www.eurocomms.com/industry-news/6511-6511)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer for CDMA Devices
positions.description:
● Architected, designed and implemented software development of CDMA Mobile Device for Indian carriers (Reliance/TATA), Brazilian carriers (VIVO) and Venezuelan carrier (Telefonica):
   o CDMA Protocol / Call Processing / SMS.
   o UI (based on Qualcomm DMSS) / OTA / Firmware. 
● Implemented carrier specific requirements. Responsible for all carrier certifications. 
● Co-ordination of various engineering group working on CDMA Mobile design.

positions.title: System Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Architected and designed WCDMA/EVDO (GENEREX-200) and RF Field optimization and network stabilization for Korean carrier (KTF). 
● Architected and designed CDMA IS-95 A/B WLL System for China, India and Romania carrier.
● Architected and designed CDMA IS-95 A/B DCN/PCS System for Korean carriers (SKT and LGU+).

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical, Electronic and Communications Engineering Technology/Technician

patents.title: Method of performing random access procedure in wireless communication system
patents.description: A method includes transmitting a random access preamble, receiving a random access response as a response of the random access preamble, wherein the random access response comprises an uplink resource assignment and a request for transmission of a Channel Quality Indicator (CQI), and transmitting the CQI in the uplink resource assignment.

patents.title: Dual mode mobile terminal in MIMO wireless communication system and controlling method thereof
patents.description: A dual mode terminal and controlling method thereof are disclosed. The present invention includes a first antenna and a second antenna. In particular, a signal received via the second antenna includes a signal generated from multiplexing an LTE downlink signal, a CDMA DCN (data core network) downlink signal and a CDMA PCS (personal communication services) downlink signal. And, the present invention is characterized in including a triplexer for demultiplexing of the downlink signals. Accordingly, a dual mode terminal of the present invention is able to receive an LTE signal without a data rate fall in the course of measuring a quality of a CDMA signal.
